title: Vampire Vape Desserts Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range delivers the nostalgic taste of creamy vanilla ice cream swirled with sweet and tangy Raspberry sauce. This dessert-inspired e-liquid blends flavours of smooth, velvety ice cream with a rich, fruity swirl that adds a delightful sweet-tart contrast, reminiscent of a classic summer treat. Blended at a 70VG/30PG ratio, this high-VG shortfill is perfect for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick vapour and a smooth, flavour-rich inhale. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there's space to add a 10ml nicotine shot to suit your preferred strength. Proudly made in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Raspberry Ripple Ice Cream is part of the indulgent Vampire Vape Desserts range — created for vapers who enjoy dessert flavours with a playful fruit twist. Also available in Freebase 10mls and DIY Concentrates.
